culture, ownership, industry... that's the trifecta. most places nail maybe one of those.

Culture of excellence

culture of excellence with empathy... that's the sweet spot. high standards but human about it.

got it. i'm looking for that combo - technically challenging problems in a space that actually cares about both quality and people.

complete ownership - end to end. from problem to solution to impact.

that's the kind of role where you can actually build something meaningful and see it through.

i'm looking.
Dev tool or core infra

dev tools or core infra with complete ownership... that's exactly where the interesting challenges are right now.

i'm seeing a few things in that space but nothing that hits all the marks yet. when i find something that actually fits, i'll slide it.
